paragraphs: DefendEye sells autonomous drones to first responders, emergency services and private security teams. A second product category is aimed at tactical, defense and government buyers. The pitch is situational awareness in seconds, an AI-powered search for people on the ground, and a drone that anyone can operate.

There is no pilot and no joystick: the operator controls the drone from a phone and launches it with a single tap. The company says deployment takes under 20 seconds through a single-button activation. Once airborne, the onboard AI locates and tags people so that officers can concentrate on the rescue. Listed flight times run up to 30 minutes on one model and up to 40 minutes on another. One version launches automatically when motion sensors detect activity and returns to land in its box. Missions can be run remotely from any location through the DefendEye Cloud platform.

The company describes itself as a technology company focused on making aerial intelligence faster, simpler and more accessible. It says its systems can support emergency response, public safety, maritime operations and industrial environments. A media section on the about page lists an August 2026 PR Newswire item about an investment led by NovaCapital to scale production. Another item there announces the integration of Starlink Mini into its tube-launched search drone. Earlier coverage listed on the same page describes the drone as the work of a Polish technology company.

quote.text: DefendEye is a technology company focused on making aerial intelligence faster, simpler and more accessible.
